pride.label: Hall of Fame
pride.line: Congrats to Lebanon's Dean Long, a 2011 Lebanon High School graduate, for being inducted into the Emporia State University baseball Hall of Fame in Emporia, Kansas, on Oct. 10. As a senior there, he led the conference with 23 home runs.

pride.label: National Budget Award
pride.line: Congrats to Lebanon's R-3 School District for earning the National Meritorious Budget Award.

pride.label: Grand Opening
pride.line: Congrats to Lebanon's R-3 School District on opening the new Robert W. Plaster Center for Student Success.

pride.label: New Head Coach
pride.line: Congrats to Lebanon's Brittany Stamm, named the new head girls basketball coach for Lebanon Schools.

pride.label: New Head Coach
pride.line: Congrats to Lebanon's Kalem Copling, named the new head boys basketball coach for Lebanon Schools.

pride.label: World Food Champ Finalists
pride.line: Congrats to Waynesville's Molly McDermitt, Cycila Keeney and Samantha Etheridge for becoming finalists in the World Food Championships in Indianapolis on Oct. 18. Their dish - Bacon Lover's Christmas.

pride.label: Teacher Award
pride.line: Congrats to Waynesville's Kyleen Oxendine, a teacher at East Elementary, for winning the 1st Quarter Project Teach Award on Oct. 19. Her Take Home Reading Success Kits help students practice reading at home.

pride.label: Tiger Spirit Trophy
pride.line: Congrats to Waynesville's Sixth Grade Center for winning the traveling Tiger Spirit Trophy again with a first-place finish in the 2026 Homecoming Parade.

pride.label: Perfect Bus Inspection
pride.line: Congrats to Waynesville's school bus mechanics and drivers, whose 10 randomly picked buses all passed a surprise Missouri State Highway Patrol inspection on Oct. 20.

pride.label: Community Recognition
pride.line: Congrats to Waynesville's Domino's for receiving the school district's Community Recognition Plaque for October for its ongoing support of students.

pride.label: Record Test Scores
pride.line: Congrats to Bolivar's school district for its strongest test results since state testing began in 1998, with 56.3 percent of students proficient in math, well above the state average.

pride.label: Banking School Grads
pride.line: Congrats to Bolivar's Lathan Martin and Boone Shockley of Grand Missouri Bank for graduating from the Oklahoma Bankers Association Consumer Lending School in Oklahoma City.

pride.label: Perfect Inspection
pride.line: Congrats to Bolivar's Parkview Health Care Facility for passing its annual state inspection with zero deficiencies.

pride.label: 100 Years in Business
pride.line: Congrats to Marshfield's Marshfield Chevrolet for celebrating 100 years of serving the community.

pride.label: Marching Band
pride.line: Congrats to Marshfield's High School marching band for taking fourth place at the Ozark Mountain Marching Festival.

pride.label: Athlete of the Week
pride.line: Congrats to Crocker's Johnny Carriger, named KY3 Athlete of the Week after scoring a hat trick in Crocker's district championship soccer game, his second of the tournament.

pride.label: Cross Country Title
pride.line: Congrats to Macks Creek's cross country teams for claiming the title and a runner-up finish at the Dixon Invitational.
